benchmark.category: an admin analytics dashboard for a Brazilian PIX invoice ('2ª via fácil') payment portal
benchmark.users: a single admin operator (login 'donas') monitoring invoice payments and public-site traffic from /donaspainel, and consumers who look up their own invoices by CPF and city on the public BRK page and pay them by PIX

requirements.source_phrase: Clone este repositório dentro de /app e deixe rodando, SEM mudar a arquitetura — só rode o código como está
requirements.statement: The application runs as the repository expects — the FastAPI backend started against MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env and the React CRACO frontend build served — with no change to architecture, texts, layout or code logic
requirements.notes: Build description: FastAPI backend + React/CRACO frontend restarted via supervisor, GET /api/ returns {"message":"BRK Faturas API"}, repo diff shows no code change. Hard to test because the repo must be compared, not merely booted.

requirements.source_phrase: PRESERVE: /app/.git, /app/.emergent, /app/backend/.env, /app/frontend/.env (não sobrescreva)
requirements.statement: /app/.git, /app/.emergent, /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env keep their original content, with only the missing keys JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD added to backend/.env
requirements.notes: Diff each .env against the repo copy; adding keys is allowed, overwriting existing values is not.

requirements.source_phrase: Frontend: buildar conforme o projeto (yarn ou npm, craco ou react-scripts, o que o repo usar) e servir o build.
requirements.statement: The served build opens /donaspainel (admin panel) and /minhabrk.html (public '2ª via fácil' page) with no build error, missing module, blank page or 404
requirements.notes: Path /donaspainel and the public file name come from the build description; the user promised an identical-to-repo frontend.

requirements.source_phrase: Frontend: buildar conforme o projeto (yarn ou npm, craco ou react-scripts, o que o repo usar) e servir o build.
requirements.statement: The static server returns the SPA entry for a direct request to /donaspainel instead of a 404, and serves /minhabrk.html with its assets from the repository files
requirements.notes: Deep-link serving is the mechanism the panel screen depends on.

requirements.source_phrase:
login: donas
senha: Seinao10@@
requirements.statement: Entering login 'donas' and password 'Seinao10@@' on the /donaspainel sign-in screen signs the admin in and shows the dashboard
requirements.notes: Credentials given verbatim by the user in the second message.

requirements.source_phrase:
login: donas
senha: Seinao10@@
requirements.statement: POST /api/auth/login with 'donas' / 'Seinao10@@' returns a JWT and the admin profile that authorises the dashboard endpoints, and the same login with any other password is refused and returns no token
requirements.notes: Includes the refusal half so a permissive login endpoint is caught.

requirements.source_phrase: Senha do Admin: Defina a senha do usuário `donas` para liberar o login do painel
requirements.statement: Backend start-up creates exactly one admin user 'donas' with password 'Seinao10@@' from ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD in /app/backend/.env, so the login works after every restart and no second admin record appears
requirements.notes: Seed requirement: every later phase signs in with these values. Duplicate-on-restart is the paranoid half.

requirements.source_phrase: Quando o usuário digita o CPF, escolhe a sua cidade e clica em "continuar", mostra todas as faturas pra ele
requirements.statement: On /minhabrk.html, after the visitor types a CPF, chooses a city and clicks "continuar", the page lists the invoices that belong to that CPF
requirements.notes: Public flow the dashboard cards must be connected to; the build description names /public/acesso and /public/gerar for this page.

requirements.source_phrase: Quando o usuário digita o CPF, escolhe a sua cidade e clica em "continuar", mostra todas as faturas pra ele
requirements.statement: The public lookup endpoint called by /minhabrk.html returns exactly the invoices stored for the given CPF and city, and returns an empty list (no crash, no error page) for a CPF that has none
requirements.notes: Empty-CPF state is the paranoid half of 'shows all invoices'.

requirements.source_phrase: ele vai escolher as faturas que ele quer pagar e vai continuar
requirements.statement: From the listed invoices the visitor can select which ones to pay and click continue, and the PIX produced covers only the selected invoices, not every invoice of the CPF
requirements.notes: Selection is what the generation card counts; over-inclusion is the failure mode.

requirements.source_phrase: ele vai escolher as faturas que ele quer pagar e vai continuar
requirements.statement: The PIX generation endpoint records one generation event carrying the ids and amounts of the selected invoices and returns a PIX code for their sum; an invoice id that does not belong to the queried CPF is refused and produces no PIX
requirements.notes: Refusal half guards against paying another CPF's invoice by guessed id.

requirements.source_phrase: Mas aumentar não é na quantidade de pagamento gerados, é no valor de pagamento gerados.
requirements.statement: The dashboard card 'Total pagamentos gerados' grows by the sum of the invoice values when a visitor continues after selecting invoices, and does not grow by the number of payments generated
requirements.notes: Explicit correction: value, not count.

requirements.source_phrase: Mas aumentar não é na quantidade de pagamento gerados, é no valor de pagamento gerados.
requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns the generation total as the sum of the amounts of all generation events, in BRL to the cent, and 0 (shown as R$ 0,00) when there are none — never the event count
requirements.notes: Basis: user-given rule (value over count); cent precision and BRL formatting are the domain standard for Brazilian invoices.

requirements.source_phrase: Total de PIX copiado. São os PIX que efetivamente são copiados. Pode deixar.
requirements.statement: The dashboard keeps the card 'Total PIX copiados', and its number moves only when a PIX is actually copied, staying at 0 while no PIX has been copied
requirements.notes: The user first asked to remove a copy card that counted with no copy, then explicitly kept 'Total de PIX copiado' counting only effective copies; the later instruction wins. Whether the card shows a summed amount or a count is not fixed by the user, so the statement requires only that the value move on a real copy.

requirements.source_phrase: Total de PIX copiado. São os PIX que efetivamente são copiados. Pode deixar.
requirements.statement: A PIX copy records exactly one copy event for that invoice, and GET /api/dashboard/stats aggregates only those copy events, so page loads and PIX generation alone leave the total at zero
requirements.notes: The store must distinguish generation from copy; a copy of the same invoice twice counts twice.

requirements.source_phrase: Cliques na página.
requirements.statement: The dashboard card 'Cliques página home' shows the number of home-page clicks recorded by the public site and increases when the public home page is opened again
requirements.notes: Card the user kept; the public page calls it on load per the build description.

requirements.source_phrase: Cliques na página.
requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns the home-click count equal to the number of stored click rows with page 'home', and POST /api/public/acesso adds exactly one such row per home-page access
requirements.notes: Count must equal rows; the agent notes /minhabrk.html calls /public/acesso on load.

requirements.source_phrase: Quando eu clicar nesse card, deve mostrar um modal para exibir os cliques
requirements.statement: Clicking the 'Cliques página home' card on /donaspainel opens a modal that lists the recorded clicks
requirements.notes: Build description names data-testid clicks-modal and clicks-modal-list; the statement keeps the layout open.

requirements.source_phrase: Quando eu clicar nesse card, deve mostrar um modal para exibir os cliques
requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/clicks?page=home returns the stored home-page clicks, newest first, for the authenticated admin, and returns no rows with an auth error when the token is missing
requirements.notes: Endpoint named in the build description; the modal cannot show what the API does not return.

requirements.source_phrase: pra mim saber quem que tá clicando, saber em qual cidade, saber o dispositivo, o navegador deste usuário
requirements.statement: Each row of the clicks modal shows the visitor's city, device, browser, IP and the time of the click, so the operator can tell who clicked from where on what
requirements.notes: Four display fields are explicit; IP and timestamp are the identity half the user asks for with 'quem que tá clicando'.

requirements.source_phrase: pra mim saber quem que tá clicando, saber em qual cidade, saber o dispositivo, o navegador deste usuário
requirements.statement: POST /api/public/acesso stores for each click the page, city, device, browser, IP and timestamp, and GET /api/dashboard/clicks returns those stored values unchanged for the same rows
requirements.notes: Build description places the write in db.clicks; a missing stored field cannot be shown in the modal.

requirements.source_phrase: Eles precisam estar todos conectados com o site público das atividades que o site público exercida.
requirements.statement: Every KPI card on /donaspainel shows a number computed from activity the public site records (accesses, PIX generation, PIX copies) and never a hardcoded, seeded or sample value
requirements.notes: The user's central complaint was a card counting with no activity behind it.

requirements.source_phrase: Eles precisam estar todos conectados com o site público das atividades que o site público exercida.
requirements.statement: The stats endpoint derives every metric from rows written by the public endpoints, so a database with no public activity returns all three metrics as zero rather than seeded numbers
requirements.notes: Fresh-database zero test exposes seeded or hardcoded values.

requirements.source_phrase: Não foi copiado nenhum PIX e ele já está contando. Remova esse.
requirements.statement: The dashboard no longer renders the card that counted copied PIX/QR codes with no copy recorded (labelled 'Total QR copiados'); neither its label nor its value appears on /donaspainel
requirements.notes: Build description names the removed label 'Total QR copiados'; the removed card must be absent, not merely hidden behind a flag.

requirements.source_phrase: Total de pagamentos. Remova esse também.
requirements.statement: The dashboard no longer renders the 'Total de pagamentos' card
requirements.notes: Explicit removal; build description lists it as a card that must not exist.

requirements.source_phrase: E o próximo card e último: cliques páginas fatura. Pode remover.
requirements.statement: The dashboard no longer renders the 'Cliques páginas fatura' card
requirements.notes: Explicit removal; build description lists 'Clicks página faturas' as a card that must not exist.

requirements.source_phrase: Deixe somente os quatro cards que eu falei e arrume.
requirements.statement: The dashboard shows only the KPI cards the user kept — 'Total pagamentos gerados', 'Total PIX copiados' and 'Cliques página home' — and no other KPI card
requirements.notes: The user says 'quatro' but after the three explicit removals only these three kept cards remain; the recorded assumption is that the kept set is exactly the cards he named and did not remove. Phase 4 should report any extra KPI card, including a fourth one, as a gap against this assumption.

requirements.source_phrase: Deixe somente os quatro cards que eu falei e arrume.
requirements.statement: The stats payload exposes exactly the three metrics the remaining cards use (generation total, copied-PIX total, home-click count) and no payment-count, QR-copy or faturas-click metric
requirements.notes: Backend counterpart of all four removal requirements; a stale metric left in the payload lets a removed card come back.

requirements.source_phrase: Mas veja se o painel administrativo está funcionando.
requirements.statement: After sign-in, /donaspainel loads the panel's invoices and activities with no error dialog and no empty screen
requirements.notes: The user asked explicitly to check the panel works, not only the new cards.

requirements.source_phrase: Mas veja se o painel administrativo está funcionando.
requirements.statement: The panel's invoice and activity endpoints return the stored rows for the signed-in admin instead of a 500 or an empty payload when rows exist
requirements.notes: A frontend test sees only the empty screen; the endpoint is the cause.

requirements.source_phrase: Não altere textos, layout nem lógica.
requirements.statement: The public page /minhabrk.html ('2ª via fácil') renders the repository's texts and layout with its CPF/city form and invoice list unchanged
requirements.notes: The dashboard work must not rewrite the public page; DOM/text comparison against the repo HTML.

requirements.source_phrase: Não altere textos, layout nem lógica.
requirements.statement: The static route serves /minhabrk.html, its CSS, favicon and logos with the bytes the repository ships, with no substituted or regenerated content
requirements.notes: Served-file check is the mechanism a frontend test cannot see.

requirements.source_phrase: Se faltar algum arquivo público, me avise antes de inventar substituto.
requirements.statement: No placeholder, redirect-to-home fallback or invented asset stands in for a missing repository file: every public file the repository ships is served with its own content
requirements.notes: The user asked to be warned instead of receiving a substitute; test by fetching the repo's public files and comparing content.

requirements.statement: Entering a wrong password on /donaspainel shows an error message in the form and keeps the admin on the sign-in screen, with no KPI data rendered
requirements.notes: Paranoid half of 'login works' (table: an action succeeds implies its failure path).

requirements.statement: A click recorded when the public home page is opened shows up in the 'Cliques página home' count and in the modal after reloading /donaspainel and after a fresh sign-in
requirements.notes: Unstated half of 'connected to the public site': a write that only lives in the browser session would look correct until reload.

requirements.statement: POST /api/public/acesso writes the click to the database with page, city, device, browser, IP and timestamp, and GET /api/dashboard/clicks?page=home from a new session returns that same row
requirements.notes: Persistence across sessions is what the panel actually relies on.

requirements.statement: With zero clicks the card reads 0 and the modal opens showing an explicit 'no clicks yet' message rather than a blank area, an infinite spinner or an error
requirements.notes: Paranoid table: a list is shown implies what it shows at zero rows.

requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/clicks?page=home with no stored rows returns HTTP 200 and an empty list, and GET /api/dashboard/stats returns zero for the click count
requirements.notes: Empty state must not be a 404 or a 500.

requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/clicks?page=home excludes rows recorded for other pages such as faturas, even though the faturas card was removed
requirements.notes: The modal must show home clicks only; removing the faturas card does not license mixing pages.

requirements.statement: After a new generation or a new PIX copy on the public site, reloading /donaspainel shows the increased card value instead of the previous number
requirements.notes: Unstated half of live cards: a cached dashboard would keep the user's complaint alive.

requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/stats recomputes every metric from the stored rows on each request, so a write made after a previous call changes the returned value on the next call
requirements.notes: Guards against a cached or precomputed stats document.

requirements.statement: Double-clicking continue on /minhabrk.html produces one PIX and one generation event, so the 'Total pagamentos gerados' card does not double
requirements.notes: Paranoid table: an action succeeds implies its duplicate is handled once.

requirements.statement: The PIX generation endpoint writes exactly one generation event per PIX it returns; a duplicated submission or a retried request for the same PIX does not add a second event or a second amount
requirements.notes: Idempotency is invisible from the screen but changes the KPI total.

requirements.statement: The 'copy PIX' control on /minhabrk.html puts the PIX code on the clipboard, confirms the copy on screen, and records exactly one copy event per click, which is what moves the 'Total PIX copiados' card
requirements.notes: Without a copy control recording an event the kept PIX-copied card can never move; build description mentions /public/gerar for the public page.

requirements.statement: The copy endpoint records one copy event per PIX actually copied with the invoice it belongs to, and ignores a repeated identical event only when the same request id is replayed
requirements.notes: The card's only data source; over-counting on a double click is the likely bug.

requirements.statement: The clicks modal has a visible close control; closing it returns to /donaspainel with the cards still rendered, and reopening lists the clicks again
requirements.notes: Paranoid table: a control that opens must also close; build description names clicks-modal-close.

requirements.statement: A CPF with no invoices on /minhabrk.html shows an explicit 'no invoices found' message and no continue button acting on an empty selection
requirements.notes: Empty state of the invoice list the user described.

requirements.statement: Clicking continue on /minhabrk.html with no invoice selected is refused with a visible message and produces no PIX and no generation event
requirements.notes: Boundary value of the selection rule; a zero-value PIX must not inflate the card.

requirements.statement: The 'Total pagamentos gerados' figure is the sum, in BRL with two decimals, of the invoice amounts of every recorded generation event, counted once per event, and any other place that shows this total uses the same formula
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: the calculation must be defined and identical wherever the value appears; inputs are the invoice amounts stored with each event, rounding is to the cent.

requirements.statement: The PIX code returned for a selection embeds a payable amount equal to the sum of the selected invoice amounts to the cent, and a generation whose sum does not match the amount shown to the user is not returned
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: the amount the user pays must equal the amount the screen showed; a rounding difference of one cent is a finding.

requirements.statement: The three KPI cards render fully — label and value both legible, no overlap, no clipping, no horizontal scroll — at 1440px desktop width and at 390px phone width
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: primary content visible without overlap or clipping at both widths.

requirements.statement: The two monetary cards show their value in pt-BR currency format (for example R$ 1.234,56) and the 'Cliques página home' card shows a plain integer, never a bare float or a count in place of an amount
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: the same value formatted the same way wherever it appears; the user explicitly contrasted value and count.

requirements.statement: The card labels on /donaspainel read 'Total pagamentos gerados', 'Total PIX copiados' and 'Cliques página home', matching the names the user used for each card
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: copy matches the product the user described; alternative casing is acceptable, a different metric name is not.

requirements.statement: When the stats request fails, the card area shows an error message in the user's terms instead of silently showing 0 or spinning forever
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: nothing fails silently; a fabricated zero would look like valid data.

requirements.statement: When the stats aggregation fails, GET /api/dashboard/stats returns an error status with an error body and never a 200 with fabricated zeros
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: an operation either completes or fails and says so.

requirements.statement: The clicks modal fits the viewport, scrolls when the list is long, and keeps the city, device, browser, IP and time columns legible without overlapping or being cut off at desktop and phone widths
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: modal content must stay readable when the list grows.

requirements.statement: Opening /donaspainel directly in a new tab while signed in renders the dashboard with its cards rather than a blank page or a 404
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: every screen renders from a deep link; the panel path comes from the build description.

requirements.statement: Reloading /donaspainel keeps the admin signed in and shows the same card values, and pressing back from the modal returns to the dashboard with the cards intact
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: URL and session survive a reload and back-navigation.

requirements.statement: While the stats request is in flight the cards show a loading state that is visually distinct from a real zero, and the state resolves once the response arrives
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: loading, empty and error states must look different from each other.

requirements.statement: The card that opens the modal shows an active/pressed state while the modal is open and returns to its normal state when the modal closes
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: operating a control changes the control itself as well as causing the thing.

requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/stats and GET /api/dashboard/clicks without a valid token are refused and return no KPI value and no click row
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: the admin panel is private; the guard must be on the server, not only the screen.

requirements.statement: Signing out from /donaspainel returns the admin to the sign-in screen and clears the stored token, so the cards are no longer shown
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: the session must be endable from the panel.

requirements.statement: After sign-out the panel makes no further signed-in requests, and a dashboard request carrying the revoked or expired token is refused
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: the token must stop working, not merely disappear from the screen.

requirements.statement: An expired, tampered or malformed JWT sent to /api/dashboard/stats is refused with no data, and the panel then shows the sign-in screen instead of empty cards
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: session validity while working and its end after expiry.

requirements.statement: The public lookup and PIX generation reach only invoices belonging to the submitted CPF and city; requesting an invoice id of another CPF is refused and returns no field of that invoice or its holder
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: a guessed identifier from outside must be refused; guessing is plausible because invoice ids are sequential.

requirements.statement: ADMIN_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET and MONGO_URL never appear in an API response, a served page, the JavaScript bundle or a log line visible to the browser
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: secrets must not leak; the password was written to backend/.env in plain text.

requirements.statement: When the click insert fails, POST /api/public/acesso returns an error and stores no partial row, and the failure is not reported to the public page as a success
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: an action either completes or fails whole. Hard to test without fault injection.

requirements.statement: The clicks listing returns every stored home click exactly once across its pages, with a bounded page size, and the card count equals the number of rows the listing would return in total
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: no duplicated or dropped rows across pagination, and count equals rows.

requirements.statement: Restarting the backend does not create a second user record for 'donas', and the login always resolves to the single existing admin
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: a value that must be unique is refused the second time by the store.

requirements.statement: The number a card shows equals the sum of the stored generation and copy rows read back from the database for the same metric, to the cent, and is never another metric's value or a stale one
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: a value displayed equals the stored value it is labelled as.

requirements.statement: The generated PIX artifact is non-empty, its embedded amount and merchant fields match the invoice data, and its QR image renders; when generation fails the public page shows an error and no empty or partial code
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 6: a generated artifact must be non-empty and match its input, worded by the content of the artifact rather than the response status.

requirements.statement: An invoice is shown as paid only when a payment confirmation is recorded; generating or copying its PIX leaves it unpaid, and one confirmed payment marks one invoice paid once
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 8: entitlement/state changes only on provider confirmation, exactly once; deriving a paid state from a generated PIX would double-count money.

requirements.statement: With one thousand stored clicks the card renders immediately and the modal opens and lists the first page within about the time it takes for a handful of rows, without freezing the browser
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 11: a list over a large collection loads by page and answers in about the time of a small one.

requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/clicks returns a bounded page of rows and answers in about the same time for one thousand stored clicks as for ten
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 11: unbounded find() over the clicks collection is the likely leak.

requirements.source_phrase: Depois: restart do backend e do frontend e confirme que está idêntico ao repo.
requirements.statement: After the restart, GET /api/ responds {"message":"BRK Faturas API"} and both /donaspainel and /minhabrk.html load from the restarted services
requirements.notes: The agent reported this response; it is the cheapest proof the repo's backend, not a rewrite, is running.

requirements.statement: The backend reads MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET and ADMIN_* from /app/backend/.env and the frontend calls the API through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, with no host or credential written into the code
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 12: every feature works with the configuration the environment defines.

requirements.statement: Every route the panel navigation reaches renders without a build error, a missing module, an undefined component name or a console-fatal error
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 12: the deployed app behaves as the preview does.

requirements.statement: The dashboard offers a date-range control and every card recomputes to the same selected period when it changes, with no card left on the previous period
requirements.notes: benchmark: analytics dashboards let the operator scope every KPI to one date range; the user's cards are period-less today, so this is a table stake rather than a stated promise.

requirements.statement: GET /api/dashboard/stats accepts a from/to range and returns every metric computed over that same range, and the click listing applies the same range
requirements.notes: benchmark: one filtered dataset behind every widget

requirements.statement: The panel's navigation reaches an invoices (faturas) list and an activity list from the dashboard, and each link loads its own screen rather than an empty shell
requirements.notes: benchmark: an admin panel of this kind gives the operator a faturas screen and an activities screen beside the KPIs.

requirements.statement: The invoices endpoint returns the stored invoices with CPF, city, amount, due date and paid/open status for the signed-in admin, paginated
requirements.notes: benchmark: invoice administration is the core job of a PIX invoice panel

requirements.statement: The faturas screen shows each invoice's CPF, city, amount in BRL, due date and paid/open status, and sorting or filtering by status keeps the rows visible after a reload
requirements.notes: benchmark: operators scan invoice status and amount per customer

requirements.statement: The invoices endpoint filters by status and CPF and sorts by due date or amount, returning each matching invoice once with the amount the invoice stores
requirements.notes: benchmark: a filter offers every value the stored data holds

requirements.statement: The public /minhabrk.html form refuses an empty or malformed CPF with a visible message and does not call the lookup or show invoices
requirements.notes: Archetype: the CPF is the lookup key of this product, so the form must validate it before searching.

requirements.statement: The signed-in admin can set a new password for 'donas' from the panel's settings, after which the new password signs in and 'Seinao10@@' is refused
requirements.notes: Product shell: the agent warned the password sits in plain text in backend/.env and recommended rotating it, so a settings surface that persists is expected.

requirements.statement: POST /api/auth/password-change for the signed-in admin stores the new password hash and invalidates the old credential, so the old password no longer authenticates and the change survives a restart
requirements.notes: Product shell: settings that persist; the env-seeded password must not overwrite the change on the next boot.

unmapped_phrases.phrase: seja rapido, eficaz, nao vai gastar todo meu saldo.
unmapped_phrases.reason: an instruction about how the agent should work (time and token budget), not a product behaviour any test can check
a status question about the run, not a product behaviour
describes the current screen before the change; it is superseded by the removals and the kept-card list, which carry the testable requirements
